info.title: CLMS QC Tool API
info.description: Programmatic access to delivery registration, product metadata, QC jobs, results, and EEA submission. Every operational request is authenticated with a named personal access token (PAT). A token captures its owner's permissions and access grants when it is created. Each request uses the intersection of that issuance snapshot and the owner's current live account access: removing access or deactivating the owner takes effect immediately, while later grants do not silently expand an existing token.

servers.description: Replaced at runtime with the configured public API URL

tags.name: Deliveries
tags.description: Register local or S3-backed deliveries and list only the deliveries visible to the token owner.

tags.name: Products
tags.description: Discover available product identifiers and the QC steps defined for a product.

tags.name: QC jobs
tags.description: Start a QC job and retrieve its status, history, JSON report, or PDF report.

tags.name: Submission
tags.description: Submit a successfully checked delivery to the configured EEA destination.

post.description: Registers a ZIP file that already exists directly inside the token owner's incoming directory. Supply either its filename or its full path. The product identified from the filename must be assigned within the token's effective access. Unclassified ZIPs require at least one product assignment; choose an assigned product when starting QC. Administrators have access to all products. Nested paths, traversal, symlinks, directories, files outside the owner's storage, and non-ZIP files are rejected. Registration creates a database record; it does not upload file bytes. A filename already registered to this owner, or reserved by an unfinished browser overwrite, returns 409. Use the browser overwrite workflow to replace a delivery.

requestBody.description: A JSON object identifying one previously uploaded ZIP file. Request bodies are limited to 16 KiB, must be UTF-8 JSON objects, and cannot contain duplicate keys.

409.description: This filename is already registered or has an unfinished overwrite.

post.description: Validates an S3 delivery and records its location. The detected product must be assigned within the token's effective access, or the token must have administrator access. An unclassified delivery requires at least one product assignment. The endpoint must be an exact HTTPS origin from the server administrator's allowlist. URL paths, query strings, fragments, embedded credentials, redirects to unapproved origins, and an excessive number of listed objects are rejected. S3 credentials are used for the configured storage operation and must never be placed in a URL.

requestBody.description: Connection details and the object prefix for one delivery. Request bodies are limited to 16 KiB and cannot contain duplicate JSON keys.

200.description: The S3-backed delivery was validated and registered.

get.description: Returns active deliveries visible through both the token's issuance snapshot and the owner's current account scope. Ordinary users see their own deliveries for assigned products, plus unclassified uploads while they have at least one assignment. Administrators and accounts with product management permissions may also see deliveries within their authorized scope. Results are paginated; no API filter or free-text search parameter is supported.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of matching rows to skip. Invalid values use 0; negative values clamp to 0; values above 10,000,000 clamp to that maximum.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum rows returned in this page. Invalid values use 20; values clamp to the inclusive range 1–1,000.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Delivery property used for ordering. Unknown values safely fall back to id.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort direction. Any value other than asc or desc safely falls back to desc.

200.description: A page of visible deliveries. next_offset is 0 when there is no subsequent page.

get.description: Returns available product identifiers within the token's effective product assignments. Administrators can see all available products. Use product_ident exactly as returned when requesting product details or creating a job.

Builds a read-only QC job blueprint for one product available within the token's effective assignments. Unassigned or unavailable products return 404. The response explains the ordered checks, which checks are required, which are system-managed, and any configured layer parameters. It does not create a job.

parameters.name: product_ident
parameters.description: Exact identifier returned by GET /product-list. URL-encode the value when constructing the path.

post.description: Creates one QC job for an existing delivery. The PAT snapshot and token owner must allow Run QC, and the owner must be allowed to manage the delivery owner. Both the delivery and the selected product must be within the token's effective product assignments; administrators may use all products. product_ident must resolve to an available definition. skip_steps may include only optional step numbers permitted by that definition.

requestBody.description: The target delivery, product identifier, and optional comma-separated step numbers. Request bodies are limited to 16 KiB and cannot contain duplicate JSON keys.

200.description: The job was accepted. data.job_uuid identifies the new job.

get.summary: Get a QC job report as JSON
get.description: Returns the compiled report for one visible job, including overall status and the ordered check results. Access uses the job's recorded product and delivery owner with the intersection of the token snapshot and the account's current administrator status and product grants. Rerunning a delivery for another product does not transfer access to earlier QC results.

get.summary: Download a QC job report as PDF
get.description: Downloads the generated PDF report for one visible job. A job can exist before its PDF artifact is ready; in that case this endpoint returns JSON with HTTP 404. Successful responses use application/pdf and a download filename.

get.summary: List a delivery's QC job history
get.description: Returns newest-first jobs associated with the selected delivery's filename and visible to the token owner. Running job states may be refreshed from the worker before the response is returned. Internal worker URLs are never exposed.

200.description: The visible job history for this delivery.

post.summary: Submit a successful delivery to EEA
post.description: Reserves and atomically publishes the latest eligible successful QC job for one owned delivery within the token's effective product assignments, or any eligible delivery for an administrator. The job must have verified exactly one product unit and reference an authoritative catalog release containing that product unit. Requests are idempotent. Competing deliveries for the same expected product unit remain published for product-manager resolution.

requestBody.description: The positive delivery ID to submit. Request bodies are limited to 16 KiB and cannot contain duplicate JSON keys.

409.description: The latest QC job, verified product unit, verified input checksum, catalog release, publication claim, or delivery lifecycle is not eligible for submission.

500.description: Submission failed after validation. The response contains a stable, non-sensitive error message.

PersonalAccessToken.description: Create a named PAT in Profile → Settings. Send it only as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. The raw value is shown once and only its digest is stored. Delete tokens individually. Effective access is the intersection of the issuance snapshot and the owner's current live access, so revocations apply immediately and later grants require a newly created token. Query-string credentials are rejected.

AuthenticationError.description: A bearer token is missing, malformed, deleted, or invalid. The response includes a WWW-Authenticate: Bearer challenge.

example.message: A Bearer API credential is required.

PermissionDenied.description: The PAT is valid, but either its issuance snapshot or its owner's current live access does not include the endpoint permission, or the owner cannot manage the target owner.

example.message: The account is not permitted to perform this action.

ObjectPermissionDenied.description: The PAT has the endpoint permission but the delivery or job is outside its effective object scope.

example.message: The account cannot access this job.

ValidationError.description: The request JSON, identifier, path, endpoint, product, optional step selection, or delivery state is invalid.

example.message: The request body is not valid JSON.

NotFound.description: The requested delivery, job, product, or generated artifact is unavailable.

example.message: The requested resource was not found.

RequestTooLarge.description: The JSON request body exceeds the endpoint's 16 KiB limit.

example.message: The request body exceeds the allowed size.

uploaded_file.description: ZIP filename or exact full path directly below the authenticated owner's incoming directory.

host.description: Exact administrator-allowlisted HTTPS S3 origin, without a path, query, fragment, or credentials.

access_key.description: S3 access key. Send only over HTTPS and never place it in a URL or log.

secret_key.description: S3 secret key. Send only over HTTPS and never place it in a URL or log.

bucketname.description: Existing bucket containing the delivery objects.

key_prefix.description: Object prefix containing exactly one logical delivery.

delivery_id.description: Positive delivery ID returned by GET /delivery-list.

skip_steps.description: Optional comma-separated, one-based step numbers. Only optional checks may be skipped. Omit or send an empty string to run all checks.

delivery_id.description: Positive delivery ID returned by GET /delivery-list.

job_uuid.description: Canonical, hyphenated identifier of the newly created job.

total.description: All deliveries visible through this PAT's effective scope.

next_offset.description: Offset for the next request, or 0 when the current page is last.

product_unit_code.description: Canonical product unit code projected from the latest QC job. Product-specific input aliases are never exposed.

verified_product_unit_code.description: Canonical product unit identity verified inside this one-ZIP delivery. It is preserved across later jobs.

content_sha256.description: Verified SHA-256 of the submitted input when available.

job_uuid.description: Compact UUID without hyphens in the history response.

product_unit_code.description: Canonical product unit code reported by this job, or null when unavailable or ambiguous.

verified_product_unit_code.description: Canonical product unit identity verified inside the ZIP by this execution.

product_unit_code.description: Canonical product unit code reported by the job, or null when unavailable or ambiguous.

verified_product_unit_code.description: Canonical product unit identity verified inside the ZIP by this execution.
